verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a homepage tagline listing "vision" among the modalities LocalAI's runtime supports, which suggests vision-language models can run but gives no detail on how images are passed alongside text. The OpenAI-compatible API claims never mention multimodal or image input, so they cannot be credited here. Missing for 10: documentation of image+text input via the chat API, named supported VLM models or backends, gallery entries for vision models, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
